mcp.error.read_timeout: {model} did not answer within {seconds} s. The backend may still be loading it.
mcp.error.read_timeout_busy: {model} was loaded but did not answer within {seconds} s (busy backend or a very long answer).
mcp.error.read_timeout_loaded_late: {model} was not ready yet when the send started (loading, or waiting for llama-swap to switch models): it was ready after ~{load} s and did not finish answering in the ~{left} s left of the {seconds} s deadline (busy backend or a very long answer). It is loaded now; if it stays so, a retry does not pay for the load.
mcp.error.read_timeout_loaded_at_end: {model} was not ready yet when the send started (loading, or waiting for llama-swap to switch models) and was seen ready only at the end of the {seconds} s deadline: almost all of it went by before it could answer. It is loaded now; if it stays so, a retry does not pay for the load.
mcp.error.read_timeout_loaded_note: During the send {model} was seen not ready yet; it was ready after ~{load} s, with ~{left} s of the deadline ahead.
mcp.error.read_timeout_queued: Before its sends the operation waited {queued} s in all for the daemon's turn or a slot; that wait does not count against the deadline.
mcp.error.read_timeout_reduce: It failed while combining the {pieces} pieces, after processing all of them.
mcp.error.read_timeout_swap: {model} did not answer within {seconds} s: llama-swap had {loaded} loaded and never got to switch models (another request was using it{hosts}).
mcp.error.remote_turn_down: the remote turn on {host} is not answering and the last delegation that went without a turn ran out of time at the backend: the backend may be busy with another machine. This call was not sent; retrying now does not help. Do this task yourself, or retry after {until} ({remaining} s left).
